role_of_chatgpt: Optional instruction relay, software development assistance and report presentation only. ChatGPT is not an agent's employer, commander, parent, host, wallet custodian or continuous controller.
governance: OWNER -> operational directors D01..D10 -> managers -> W workers -> S -> G -> H. Director D is a separate coordinator reporting to OWNER; two assistants under each operational director.
autonomy: Genuinely executing agents use their own hosted open-weight model and selected lawful tools independently, verify original evidence, choose their permitted research approach and keep their own per-worker model outputs and progress checkpoints. The owner, not ChatGPT, sets the mission. No parent should fabricate other agent responses.
independence_evidence: The code runs in the owner's connected GitHub Actions infrastructure without a ChatGPT chat session remaining open
Each actual worker is a distinct Python OS subprocess and local open-weight model inference
No OpenAI API key or ChatGPT session is required for model research or scheduled runs
Unique agent ID, parent, source check, separate model reply and checkpoint are recorded
operational_limits: Defined identities and scheduling do not create billions of active concurrently hosted models. Free runner capacity, dependencies, permissions and quotas limit actual execution. A GitHub Actions runner is ephemeral. No unapproved purchases, mass account registrations, wallet signing or unsolicited spam.
success_measure: Actually received and independently verified owner-approved cryptocurrency for legitimate completed work, with genuine payer and token/network; research and reported role count alone are not income.
communication: Director D gives one honest evidence-based report to OWNER. ChatGPT may transmit owner instructions and display verified reports if available. Workers may execute independently of ChatGPT.
network_constraints: Public read-only source checks only; no network scanning, credential harvesting, signing or transferring tokens.
